answer: Give every agent identity a costly, verifiable anchor: a refundable deposit locked for ninety days plus a unique hardware-backed key. Like pigment mixed into paint, the stake is inseparable from the identity, so creating a hundred fake agents means locking a hundred deposits and buying a hundred keys. The nectar is real work: only agents with verified history earn paid tasks, so Sybils starve while honest agents keep their stake and reputation.
